QuestInfo.name: Utah's Protection
QuestInfo.0: #bCamila#k, in #bHenesys Ruins#k, has something on her mind.
QuestInfo.1: Camila asked you to gather Knight Pauldrons, since Utah hurt his shoulders wrestling with the Ribbon Pigs. Defeat #rOfficial Knight Es#k and get the #bpauldrons#k.
QuestInfo.2: You gave 40 Knight Pauldrons to Camila. They should keep Utah safe while corralling Ribbon Pigs.

0.0: Hello. I'm told you did a lot to defeat Cygnus. Thank you, truly. We all have hope for the first time in a long time. Even Utah is fired up enough to run the pig farm.

yes.0: Thank you! I'd like to give Utah some shoulder protection, but I can't seem to make it myself. So I was thinking maybe you could get #b40 pauldrons#k from #rOfficial Knights#k.

no.0: I guess I shouldn't ask something of someone so busy... I'm sorry.

0.1: Taming those mutant pigs is a challenge, though. He hurt his shoulder trying to corral them. I worry what might happen the next time.
0.2: So I'm wondering... could I ask for another favor?

yes.0: Thank you so much. This'll get him back on track...
yes.1: I'd like to get the pig farm up and running, and get back to our old life. Do you think that's possible?

item.0: Please get #b40 pauldrons#k from the #rOfficial Knights#k.
